about: [O7 after the critic, B2] the wanted man by medium hands: by his corner he turns ('Looking for me?') and fights (O4's crowd brawl); beaten once he gets up and runs; run down; E takes him in ('Come on.'); at the board the full reward. Through in one to three tries.

steps.label: medium hands: taken in within three tries

steps.eval: (() => { const B = G.night.bounty.board(); G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(B.standX, B.standZ); N.controller.setPose(B.standX + B.nx * 0.4, B.standZ + B.nz * 0.4, Math.atan2(B.nx, B.nz), 0); return 1; })()

steps.label: at the board: the full reward for a man taken in
